instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Hand one prompt (an issue, a task) to a coding AI app the person already has on their computer, such as Claude Code or Codex", and give it app (The app's id from read-data/open-in-ai.json (for example claude-code or codex)); prompt (The prompt to open).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:open-in-ai and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Opens the prompt in the app named by `app`, one of the rows of read-data/open-in-ai.json (the rows are the allowlist; an app not in them is refused).
